# Phase One — Surface and Theoretical File Map

The Awtsmoos gives each route a boundary, each boundary a task, each task a vessel of light.
Awtsmoos.com must be repaired by traced ownership, so no living neighbor is overwritten in the night.

## Public Surface Graph

`geelooy/` is source-root, not a browser prefix. A file such as `geelooy/mawgawl/sefarim/index.html` corresponds to `/mawgawl/sefarim/` on the local web server.

### Screenshot Families

- `/mawgawl/sefarim/` → source-search / Torah library experience. Current scoped Git status is clean; safe first implementation candidate.
- `/games/shema-strike/` → platform game. Active CSS/index edits exist; audit-only during this wave.
- `/games/ohrfront/` → first-person game. Extensive active source/style/test work exists; audit-only during this wave.
- `/social-composer/` → rich-post composer. Another active agent is changing command-palette/v15 UI; audit-only during this wave.
- `/apps/animator/` → editor/canvas experience. Existing repository status shows active Animator work; audit-only during this wave.
- `/games/mitzvahWorld/` and related game systems → active agents are present; audit-only during this wave.

New tests are not designed until the first source draft exists, per repository coding law.

## Theoretical Rewrite Shapes

### Shape A — Markup/CSS-only reconstruction

Rewrite `index.html` plus the smallest set of existing route-local CSS owners. Preserve all JS and APIs if progressive disclosure already exists and only presentation/wiring is incomplete.

### Shape B — Markup/CSS + existing disclosure controller

Rewrite `index.html`, selected CSS, and the complete `SearchControlDisclosure.js` file only if source tracing proves the controller cannot support the desired compact task flow.

### Shape C — New context coordinator

Only if current controllers mix unrelated responsibilities, create one small route-local coordinator for context-panel state and compose it from existing controllers. Do not invent this unless real code proves it necessary.

## Mutation Boundary

No production file is approved for mutation until the remaining Sefarim owners are read and scoped Git status is refreshed. No dirty screenshot family is approved for mutation in this phase.

## NEXT_ACTION

Read the primary Sefarim layout/form/discovery/responsive CSS and orchestration/disclosure JS in full, then write the Phase Two critique with at least twenty evidence-driven improvements.
